headline: Nigerian Banks Post Africa's Lowest Loan Ratios Amid Recapitalisation
summary: Nigeria's largest banking groups recorded the five lowest loan-to-deposit ratios among leading African lenders in 2025 as recapitalisation crowded out credit.
why: Low loan-to-deposit ratios indicate subdued lending to the real economy, reflecting banking sector risk aversion and capital adequacy adjustments.

impacts.name: Nigerian Banking Sector
impacts.why: Lenders in Nigeria are holding low loan-to-deposit ratios as recapitalisation crowds out credit.
